name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 28 – Am 72
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 28b. Underlines the fact that Ukraine received unprecedented support of EUR 134 billion from the EU and Member States up to 2024; demands that the EU’s financial interests and the protection of these funds be ensured and guaranteed in the same way as within the European Union;
